feeding_claim.verbatim: 100% grass-fed and grass-finished, moved to fresh pasture daily.

pickup_locations: Fulfillment center, 90 West McClarnon Dr, Greenfield, Monday to Friday 8am to 12pm

resold_note: Also sells pork from Gunthorp Farms and other local producers, raw dairy from Kemp Family Organic Dairy, wild Alaska sockeye salmon and other foods from partner producers.
notes: Read the homepage, our farm, our practices, FAQ, contact, grass-fed beef collection and local pork collection pages (WebFetch summaries only, so recheck the verbatim quote on the page). Our farm page says the farm raises grass-fed beef and pasture-raised chicken and works with partners for pork and raw dairy. Eggs are unclear: the pork page says eggs come from its own farm but the homepage lists eggs among partner products, so eggs were left out. Beef collection says cattle are never grain-finished. Local delivery across Central Indiana (ZIP check); frozen shipping of beef and chicken to the continental United States; in-store pickup at the Greenfield fulfillment center weekdays 8am to noon. Farm sites at 7408 E. 200 S, Greenfield and 8488 E. 500 S, Carthage. Bundles include 1/8 of a cow; no quarter, half or whole shares found. Homepage meta says pastures are certified organic; not checked against the USDA list. No phone on the site. Freezer Beef & Bundles collection and page 2 of the beef collection not read.
